At reference rock ($V_{S30}=760$ m/s), mean PGA reaches `r .fmt(HazardSummary$pga[Vs30 == 760 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g for $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]])`$ years and `r .fmt(HazardSummary$pga[Vs30 == 760 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g for $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]])`$ years; the maxima of the mean UHS are `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g at `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]] & p == "mean", Tn], 2)` s and `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]] & p == "mean", SaF])` g at `r .fmt(HazardSummary$peak[TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]] & p == "mean", Tn], 2)` s, respectively. The reference-rock output reports the mean; the fractiles at $V_{S30}=800$ m/s correspond to that site condition.

The modal disaggregation scenarios for PGA are $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], Mw], 1)` at `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], R])` km for $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]])`$ years and $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], Mw], 1)` at `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], R])` km for $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]])`$ years; for $S_a(1.0\,\mathrm{s})$ they are $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], Mw], 1)` at `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], R])` km and $M_w$ `r .fmt(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], Mw], 1)` at `r .fmti(HazardSummary$modal[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], R])` km at those same return periods.

The largest by-source contribution for PGA corresponds to `r HazardSummary$source[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], providerID]` (`r HazardSummary$source[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], tectonicRegion]`) at $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]])`$ years and to `r HazardSummary$source[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], providerID]` (`r HazardSummary$source[Tn == Tn.PGA & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], tectonicRegion]`) at $T_R=`r .fmti(HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]])`$ years; for $S_a(1.0\,\mathrm{s})$ it corresponds to `r HazardSummary$source[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], providerID]` (`r HazardSummary$source[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[1L]], tectonicRegion]`) and `r HazardSummary$source[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], providerID]` (`r HazardSummary$source[Tn == 1 & TR == HazardSummary$returnPeriods[[2L]], tectonicRegion]`) at those same return periods.
